data.name: Heading
data.comment: Heading above the people section on the Account page.

data.name: CollectionYours
data.comment: Under a collection in the list on this device: the person's own.

data.name: CollectionShared
data.comment: Under a shared collection in the list. {0} is the owner's name, {1} what the person can do, like 'edit'.

data.name: CollectionSharedNoOwner
data.comment: Under a shared collection whose owner's name isn't known yet. {0} is what the person can do, like 'edit'.

data.name: CollectionGone
data.comment: Under a collection the person was removed from.

data.name: Open
data.comment: Button that opens another collection.

data.name: RoleCanView
data.comment: A role in a shared collection. Used in lists and choices.

data.name: RoleCanLog
data.comment: A role in a shared collection. Can add care entries, notes and photos.

data.name: RoleCanEdit
data.comment: A role in a shared collection. Can change everything.

data.name: RoleCanEditAndManage
data.comment: A role in a shared collection. Can change everything and invite and manage people.

data.name: VerbView
data.comment: What a role lets the person do, after 'You can'. Matches RoleCanView.

data.name: VerbLog
data.comment: What a role lets the person do, after 'You can'. Matches RoleCanLog.

data.name: VerbEdit
data.comment: What a role lets the person do, after 'You can'. Matches RoleCanEdit.

data.name: VerbEditAndManage
data.comment: What a role lets the person do, after 'You can'. Matches RoleCanEditAndManage.

data.name: CollectionName
data.comment: Label for the box that renames the open collection.

data.name: GoneText
data.value: You're no longer in this collection. What's on this device stays until you remove it.

data.name: BackupFailed
data.value: Couldn't save the backup. Try again.

data.name: RemoveFromDeviceExplain
data.value: Removes {0} and its photos from this device. Your own collection isn't touched.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the collection.

data.name: NoNameYet
data.comment: Shown for a member who hasn't set a name.

data.name: You
data.comment: After the person's own name in the list of members.

data.name: MemberOwner
data.comment: Under the owner in the list of members. {0} is their role, like 'Can edit and add people'.

data.name: ChangeRoleFor
data.comment: Read out for the choice of a member's role. {0} is the member's name.

data.name: RemoveMemberExplain
data.value: Remove {0}? They keep nothing of this collection on the server. What they logged stays.
data.comment: {0} is the member's name.

data.name: InviteChoose
data.comment: Heading over the choice of role for an invite.

data.name: InviteLinkHint
data.value: Anyone with this link can join and {0}. It works once and runs out in {1} days.
data.comment: {0} is what the invited person can do, like 'edit'. {1} is the number of days.

data.name: ShareTitle
data.comment: Title sent along when the invite link is shared. {0} is the collection's name.

data.name: ShowQr
data.comment: Button that shows the invite link as a QR code.

data.name: QrDescription
data.value: QR code for the invite link
data.comment: Read out for the picture of the QR code.

data.name: InviteRunsOut
data.comment: {0} is a date.

data.name: Withdraw
data.comment: Button that cancels an invite link.

data.name: HandOverHint
data.value: Anyone in the collection can take over. They become the owner and an editor who adds people.

data.name: HandOverConfirm
data.value: {0} becomes the owner. You stay as an editor who adds people.
data.comment: {0} is the new owner's name.

data.name: LeaveConfirm
data.value: Leave {0}? It is taken off this device. You can join again with a new invite.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the collection.

data.name: OwnerCantLeave
data.value: You own this collection, so you can't leave it. Hand it over first.

data.name: YourNameHint
data.value: Shown to the people you share with, and next to what you log.

data.name: NameDialogHint
data.value: Shown to the people you share with.

data.name: JoinTitle
data.comment: Title of the page an invite link opens.

data.name: JoinSignIn
data.value: Sign in or make a free account. You come back here afterwards.

data.name: JoinInvites
data.comment: {0} is the name of the person, {1} the name of the collection.

data.name: JoinInvitesNoName
data.comment: {0} is the name of the collection. Used when the person who invited hasn't set a name.

data.name: AlreadyMember
data.comment: {0} is the name of the collection.

data.name: JoinNotFound
data.value: This invite link doesn't work. Check that the whole link came through, or ask for a new one.

data.name: JoinGone
data.value: This invite has run out or was withdrawn. Ask for a new one.

data.name: JoinFull
data.value: {0} already has as many people as it can have ({1}).
data.comment: {0} is the name of the collection, {1} the most people it can hold.

data.name: TooManyInvites
data.value: You've made a lot of invites today. Try again tomorrow, or withdraw some open ones.

data.name: OwnerCantLeaveProblem
data.value: You own this collection. Hand it over before you leave.

data.name: NotAllowed
data.value: You can't do that here any more. Your place in this collection may have changed.

data.name: NeedsLength
data.value: A name needs between 1 and {0} characters.
data.comment: {0} is the most characters a name can have.

data.name: CantChangeHere
data.value: You can't change this in {0}. {1} can give you more rights.
data.comment: Shown instead of a page that only changes things, for someone who can't. {0} is the collection's name, {1} the owner's name.

data.name: CantChangeHereNoOwner
data.value: You can't change this in {0}. The owner can give you more rights.
data.comment: Same, when the owner's name isn't known yet.

data.name: ByName
data.comment: After an entry in a shared collection that someone else made. {0} is their name.

data.name: OpenLine
data.comment: A quiet line on the main pages while a shared collection is open. {0} is the owner's name with its possessive ending (Alma's), {1} what the person can do, like 'edit'.

data.name: OpenLineNoOwner
data.comment: Same, when the owner's name isn't known yet. {0} is the collection's name.

data.name: OpenLineGone
data.value: You're no longer in {0}. Nothing here syncs.
data.comment: The same line when the person was removed from the collection. {0} is its name.

data.name: EmptyPlants
data.value: Nothing here yet. {0} hasn't added any plants.
data.comment: Empty plant list for someone who can't add plants. {0} is the owner's name.

data.name: EmptyPlantsNoOwner
data.value: Nothing here yet. Nobody has added any plants.

data.name: EmptyPropagations
data.value: Nothing here yet. {0} hasn't added any propagations.
data.comment: Empty propagation list for someone who can't add. {0} is the owner's name.

data.name: EmptyPropagationsNoOwner
data.value: Nothing here yet. Nobody has added any propagations.

data.name: EmptyToday
data.value: Nothing here yet. {0} hasn't added any plants.
data.comment: Empty Today page for someone who can't add plants. {0} is the owner's name.

data.name: EmptyTodayNoOwner
data.value: Nothing here yet. Nobody has added any plants.

data.name: CantChangeTitle
data.comment: Page title and hidden heading of the notice shown instead of a page the person can't use in the open collection.

data.name: NameYours
data.comment: What a collection is called when it still has the name the server gave it and it is the person's own.

data.name: NameOwners
data.comment: What someone else's collection is called when it still has the name the server gave it. {0} is the owner's name with its possessive ending (Alma's).

data.name: RemoveNeedsOwnCollection
data.value: To remove the data from this device, open your own collection first, so it can check that everything has been sent.
data.comment: Shown instead of the option to remove the data when signing out or deleting the account while a shared collection is open.

data.name: CopyFailed
data.value: The link couldn't be copied automatically. It's selected, so you can copy it yourself.
data.comment: Shown under the invite link when the browser wouldn't let the app copy it.

data.name: CollectionTitle
data.comment: Label above the collection's name in the People section on the Account page, when there is only one collection on the device.

data.name: RoleMeaningView
data.comment: Under 'Can view' when choosing what an invited person can do.

data.name: RoleMeaningLog
data.value: Logs care and adds notes and photos. Changes only what they added. Suits a plant-sitter.
data.comment: Under 'Can log care' when choosing what an invited person can do.

data.name: RoleMeaningEdit
data.comment: Under 'Can edit' when choosing what an invited person can do.

data.name: RoleMeaningEditAndManage
data.value: Changes anything, and also invites others and decides who can do what.
data.comment: Under 'Can edit and add people' when choosing what an invited person can do.

data.name: JoinRoleView
data.value: You can see everything in it, but not change anything.
data.comment: On the page an invite link opens, under who invited the person. For an invite that can view.

data.name: JoinRoleLog
data.value: You can log care on plants and cuttings and add notes and photos, and change what you added yourself.
data.comment: On the page an invite link opens. For an invite that can log care.

data.name: JoinRoleEdit
data.value: You can change anything in it, like the owner.
data.comment: On the page an invite link opens. For an invite that can edit.

data.name: JoinRoleEditAndManage
data.value: You can change anything in it, invite others and change who can do what.
data.comment: On the page an invite link opens. For an invite that can edit and add people.

data.name: JoinOwnStay
data.value: Your own plants stay as they are.
data.comment: On the page an invite link opens, under what the invite allows.

data.name: JoinAboutStikling
data.value: Stikling is a free app to keep track of your plants and the cuttings you take from them, with photos and notes for each one.
data.comment: On the page an invite link opens, when the person isn't signed in. Says what the app is.

data.name: JoinSignInButton
data.comment: Button on the page an invite link opens, when the person isn't signed in.

data.name: RaiseConfirm
data.value: Let {0} edit and add people? They can invite others and change who can do what.
data.comment: Question under a member when the owner picks 'Can edit and add people' for them. {0} is the member's name.

data.name: RaiseConfirmButton
data.comment: Button on the question about letting a member edit and add people.

data.name: InviteMadeRunsOut
data.comment: Under an open invite in the People section. {0} is the date it was made, {1} the name of who made it, {2} the date it runs out.

data.name: ShowLink
data.comment: Button next to an open invite in the People section. Shows its link and QR code again.

data.name: LeaveHint
data.value: The collection goes from this device. You can join again with a new invite.
data.comment: Under the Leave button in the People section.

data.name: SwitcherTitle
data.comment: Title of the small sheet that opens from the line at the top of Today, Plants and Cuttings saying whose collection is open.

data.name: SwitcherManage
data.comment: Link at the bottom of the collection switcher, to the People section on the Account page.
